Subject: Brightlane governance kickoff: committee schedule + docs we need

Hi Lisa / Mark — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a few asks to keep momentum for the exec committee kickoff:

1) High-level decision criteria (as we heard):
   - Latency SLO for customer-facing recommendations (p95 < 150ms)
   - Total cost per 1M tokens + predictable monthly committed spend
   - Data residency and ability to run in a private VPC for PII workloads
   - Clear SLAs and auditability for logs/usage

2) Economic buyer / committee: you mentioned Mark Liu (CFO) as the economic sponsor, and Lisa you will coordinate the rest of the steering committee.

3) Immediate outstanding items from Brightlane we need before the kickoff:
   - Confirmation of steering committee attendees and preferred 60–90 minute slots (see proposed times below)
   - Latest procurement timeline and any internal blackout dates for Sep/Oct
   - Primary legal/procurement contact for contract redlines and SOC 2/DPA requests

Proposed windows (please pick two preferred):
   - Wed 2026-09-01 10:00–11:15 PT
   - Thu 2026-09-02 13:00–14:30 PT
   - Tue 2026-09-07 09:00–10:30 PT

I've attached a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) and a draft steering agenda to help set expectations. Can we aim to lock a date this week? If Mark wants a brief pre-brief (15 min) before the larger committee, we can absolutely do that.

Subject: Re: Brightlane governance kickoff: committee schedule + docs we need

Hi Daniel — we typically handle commercial redlines in Word with tracked changes for the first pass and then move to a DocuSign package once terms are agreed. A couple of items I want to call out early so your team can flag them internally: 

 - Data retention: our standard is 90 days of raw request logs, 13 months of aggregated telemetry; configurable by customer in Private deployments. If Brightlane requires longer retention we can accommodate with a SaaS addendum.
 - Encryption/key management: we support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) for Private deployments; hosted API uses provider-managed KMS.
 - Subprocessors: we will provide an up-to-date subprocessors list; we require a standard subprocessors clause.

We’ll share a tracked-change DPA draft by Thursday. If you have any nonstandard contract terms (e.g., specific audit windows or additional liability caps), please send them over so we can address up front.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
